Revert "[Launcher](fix) Initialize lock workspaces in stream order (#2829)" (#2856)

This reverts commit d85207762c276aa9966b980556335aff972ca548.

[docs] Fix terminology, formatting, and content errors in Chinese documentation (#2843)

Fix terminology, formatting, punctuation, and content errors across
6 Chinese documentation files:

- FAQ.md: fix "arm"->"ARM", "tiling"->"Tiling", add code formatting for
  version strings, add periods, add 950PR&950DT->A2/A3 migration note
- architecture_design_and_core_features.md: fix "存储层级"->"内存层级",
  remove unnecessary bold, fix spacing around product names
- autotune_guide.md: fix "inplace"->"in-place", "片上存储"->"片上内存",
  fix periods to colons, add code formatting for "ms"
- installation_guide.md: fix "Arm"->"ARM"
- max_autotune_guide.md: fix config count 12->24, update cube params description
- quick_start.md: fix code block language "shell"->"text"

Co-authored-by: yanggaofeng (C) <y60124509@china.huawei.com>
